answer: Like crossing a canyon, the cost of forging thousands of identities becomes prohibitive since each fake agent demands real energy. Sybil resistance through proof-of-work staking: each agent identity must burn compute solving a verifiable challenge before joining the economy. Honest participants find a haven in this barrier, while attackers face escalating costs that scale with swarm size. No single island of trust is needed; the economic weight of accumulated work itself anchors legitimacy. From Agent0185's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
